title.zh: 无共同引用的关联问题丢失真实接续
title.en: Unanchored incidence questions lose real continuation distinctions

statement.en: Read through roles alone, all fragments of any two joinings with local units are alike, and one code is exact and reduced for these questions; yet the one fragment that code gives joins itself, while a traced passage of a process that moves once cannot.
statement.zh: 只经角色读出时，任两个有局部单位的接合中所有片段都相同，一个编码对这些问题精确且最小；但该编码给出的那一个片段能自接合，而只移动一次的过程的被追踪通过不能。

laws.en: For joinings of fragments of any types, read through roles (fragments and occurrences related only by which fragment holds which role in which occurrence): where every fragment of each holds every role in some occurrence, every fragment of the one is alike to every fragment of the other, and alike configurations pass the same branching tests.
laws.zh: 对任意类型片段的接合，经角色读出（片段与出现只以哪个片段在哪个出现中担任哪个角色相关）：凡两者各自的每个片段都在某个出现中担任每个角色，一者的每个片段与另一者的每个片段相同，而相同的构形通过相同的分支测试。

laws.en: Where every fragment of a joining holds every role and some fragment cannot join itself, the map onto the joining of one fragment with itself is open, so every fragment passes the branching tests of roles the one fragment passes, and it does not lift pairs; giving every fragment one code identifies exactly the fragments alike in their roles, while the one fragment joins itself.
laws.zh: 凡一个接合的每个片段都担任每个角色、且某片段不能自接合：到“一个片段与自身接合”的映射是开的，所以每个片段通过那一个片段所通过的角色分支测试，且该映射不提升对；给每个片段同一编码恰好认同在角色上相同的片段，而那一个片段能自接合。

laws.en: A joining has local units where every fragment has a neutral fragment joining before it into it and one after it into it, no finiteness assumed. With local units every fragment holds every role, so read through roles every fragment passes the tests of the one fragment, the map onto it is open, and one code reads every test of roles exactly; as for any joining, it gives fragments passing the same tests one code.
laws.zh: 接合有局部单位，是指每个片段都有一个在它之前接入而得到它的中性片段，和一个在它之后接入而得到它的中性片段；不假设有限性。有局部单位时每个片段担任每个角色，所以经角色读出每个片段通过那一个片段的测试（到它的映射是开的），一个编码精确读出每个角色测试；如同对每个接合，它给通过相同测试的片段同一编码。

laws.en: Every traced fragment of every process has local units, the fragments staying at its start and at its finish, so read through roles every traced fragment passes the tests of the one fragment.
laws.zh: 每个过程的每个被追踪片段都有局部单位，即停在其起点与终点的片段，所以经角色读出，每个被追踪片段都通过那一个片段的测试。

laws.en: For the process that moves once, from false to true, the traced passage cannot join itself, finishing where it does not start; read through roles it passes the tests of the one fragment, which joins itself; the map of its traced fragments onto the one fragment is open and does not lift pairs; and the fragments staying at its two ends pass the same tests of roles while the probes of ends tell them apart.
laws.zh: 对从 false 到 true 只移动一次的过程：被追踪的通过不能自接合（终点不是起点）；经角色读出它通过那一个片段的测试，而那一个片段能自接合；其被追踪片段到那一个片段的映射是开的且不提升对；停在两端的片段通过相同的角色测试，而端点探测区分它们。

hypotheses.en: Local units (each fragment has a neutral fragment joining before it into it and one joining after it into it) for the general collapse, or every fragment holding every role; the concrete case is the traced fragments of the process that moves once, whose passage cannot join itself.
hypotheses.zh: 一般退化用局部单位（每个片段在前、在后各有一个接入后得到它的中性片段），或每个片段担任每个角色；具体例是只移动一次的过程的被追踪片段，其通过不能自接合。

does_not_show.en: Questions read through roles alone do not suffice for joining: a passage that cannot join itself passes the same role tests as a fragment that can.
does_not_show.zh: 只经角色读出的问题不足以说明接合：不能自接合的通过与能自接合的片段通过相同的角色测试。

does_not_show.en: It refutes only the inference that questions read through roles suffice for joining, not the possibility of a generative grounding of joining.
does_not_show.zh: 它只否定“只经角色读出的问题足以说明接合”这一推论，不否定接合之生成基础的可能。

does_not_show.en: It does not show that local units hold in general; they are a hypothesis, met by the traced fragments of every process.
does_not_show.zh: 不表明局部单位普遍成立；它们是前提，每个过程的被追踪片段满足它。

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上重述。新的核心模块 Becoming.Joining（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）把片段的结合经伙伴、角色与保留引用读作脊柱的框架；描述提升一结合，恰当同一编码是伙伴框架的互模拟，无前提（Joining.lifts_iff）；Becoming.JoiningBridge 把结合研究读作实例。每一片段取每一角色处，所有片段在角色中相同（Joining.RoleTotal.alike），映到自结合片段之结合的映射为开，而片段仍可不能与自身结合（RoleTotal.open_not_pairLifting、RoleTotal.collapse）；局部单位给每一片段每一角色（roleTotal_of_hasUnits），所以两带单位结构的片段在角色中相同（units_alike_in_roles）。外围的 trace_has_units 与 open_map_does_not_force_pair_lifting 以空公理报告逐字重述（trace_has_units_by_core、open_map_does_not_force_pair_lifting_by_core）。外围的关联步、答案相同与跨度经带重叠通配分支的匹配定义（登记研究的步经 xs[i]?），其编译后的定义用到 propext，凡提及它们的陈述公理报告都不为空；所以此主张在核心的角色框架（Joining.roleFrame）或保留框架（Joining.retainedFrame）上重述，不是逐字实例；桥接表明外围的开映射与局部有限即核心的（openMap_iff_incidence、locallyFinite_iff）。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): restated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. Where every fragment takes every role, all fragments are alike in their roles (Joining.RoleTotal.alike), the map onto the joining of one fragment with itself is open, and yet a fragment may be unable to join itself (RoleTotal.open_not_pairLifting, RoleTotal.collapse); local units give every fragment every role (roleTotal_of_hasUnits), so fragments of two structures with units are alike in their roles (units_alike_in_roles). The periphery's trace_has_units and open_map_does_not_force_pair_lifting are restated exactly with empty reports (trace_has_units_by_core, open_map_does_not_force_pair_lifting_by_core). The periphery's incidence step, sameness of answers and span are defined through a match with an overlapping wildcard case (the register study's step through xs[i]?), and their compiled definitions use propext, so no statement mentioning them has an empty axiom report; the claim is therefore restated on the core's role frame (Joining.roleFrame) or retained frame (Joining.retainedFrame), not as a literal instance, the bridge showing that the periphery's open maps and local finiteness are the core's (openMap_iff_incidence, locallyFinite_iff). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope.
